boss_respawner.configuration.title: Universal Boss Respawner Configs
boss_respawner.configuration.general.too: Global behavior settings for respawn cages.
boss_respawner.configuration.general.ena: Master switch for all respawn cage logic. When false, no cages are placed or spawned.
boss_respawner.configuration.general.log: Log when respawn cages are placed, skipped, or spawned.
boss_respawner.configuration.compat.fore: Block IDs from other mods that should be treated as foreign respawn cages/altars. Placement avoids these blocks.
boss_respawner.message.respawn_failed: The boss respawner at %s failed to summon the boss after several attempts and has reset.
